labels.text: Stop recording and edit the transcript

S49.01.note: The microphone button has no visible text, only an accessible label; the Settings switch that enables it is described under S49.03.
steps: Sign in and open a chat with an empty message box.
Click the microphone button next to the message box, labelled "Start voice input".
Say a short sentence while the recording strip is shown.
Click "Stop recording and edit the transcript" (the square button).
Wait for "Transcribing" to disappear, then look at the message box: the spoken words should appear there, as in Expected.
S49.01.where: Message box > microphone button (no visible text; its label is "Start voice input"), then "Stop recording and edit the transcript"

labels.text: Stop recording and edit the transcript

S49.02.note: Pressing Enter while recording sends the transcript straight away (DictationStrip.tsx handleKeyDown), so testers should not press Enter if they want to edit first.
steps: Start dictation with the "Start voice input" microphone button and say a sentence.
Click "Stop recording and edit the transcript".
When "Transcribing" finishes, click into the message box.
Edit a word in the transcript, then check that the text changed and nothing has been sent yet.
S49.02.where: Message box > microphone button "Start voice input", then "Stop recording and edit the transcript"

S49.03.note: The code does not show how the Settings window is opened from the app; the path above starts at the Settings screen.
steps: Open Settings and click "Voice".
Make sure the "Dictation" switch is on.
Open the "Dictation language" dropdown and choose a different language.
Close Settings, click "Start voice input", and speak in the chosen language.
Check that the transcript comes back in that language, as in Expected.
S49.03.where: Settings > Voice > "Dictation language" (dropdown under the Dictation switch)

S49.05.note: The "Transcript ready" text is only announced to screen readers (use-dictation.ts), not shown on screen.
steps: Click "Start voice input", say a sentence, then click "Stop recording and edit the transcript".
Watch the strip show "Transcribing".
When the strip goes away, look at the message box for the final transcript.
Compare the text with what you said.
S49.05.where: Message box > "Start voice input" microphone button, then "Stop recording and edit the transcript"

S49.06.needs: a microphone; a way to make transcription fail (the code does not say how a tester should cause a failure)
S49.06.note: The failure message in the code reads "That recording could not be transcribed. Try again." (use-dictation.ts); the "Try again" button is in DictationStrip.tsx.
steps: Click "Start voice input", say a sentence, then click "Stop recording and edit the transcript".
If transcription fails, the strip shows an error with a "Try again" button (or "Dismiss voice input error" to close it).
Click "Try again" and check that the transcript is produced without recording again.
Compare with Expected.
S49.06.where: Message box > "Start voice input" microphone button; on failure the strip shows "Try again"

steps: Click "Start voice input" and say a sentence.
Click "Discard recording" (the X button at the left of the strip).
Check that the strip closes and the message box is unchanged, with no transcript added.
Optional: repeat and press Escape instead of clicking the X; the recording should be discarded the same way.
S49.07.where: Message box > "Start voice input" microphone button, then the round "Discard recording" button at the left of the strip

labels.text: Stop recording and edit the transcript

S49.09.note: The transcription handler file does not name its mode; batch behaviour is inferred from the single POST and the Transcribing state, not verified against a running request.
steps: Click "Start voice input", say a longer sentence, then click "Stop recording and edit the transcript".
Watch the strip: no partial text appears while speaking; "Transcribing" shows until the whole transcript is ready.
Compare with Expected: the full transcript arrives in one piece after the recording stops.
S49.09.where: Effect seen in the message box: the whole recording appears as one transcript after "Transcribing"; the request is made by the transcription endpoint (apps/web/app/api/voice/transcribe/route.ts)

S49.10.note: The live path is a voice call (live-voice-session.ts), not the dictation strip; the code shows transcript turns but not where they are shown on screen, so the exact spot is unverified.
steps: Sign in, open a chat and leave the message box empty.
Click the button labelled "Start voice mode" (it appears next to the message box when there is no text).
Allow the microphone and speak; watch whether your words appear as text while you are still talking.
Click "End voice session" when done.
S49.10.where: Message box (empty) > "Start voice mode" button, then the live call screen with "End voice session"

S49.17.note: Searched apps/web for notice, agree, consent and recorded in the voice, composer, dictation and live-voice files; found no recording notice. The only consent code is for named model providers (apps/web/features/models), which is unrelated.

S49.25.needs: a conversation with dictated or voice text
S49.25.note: No transcript-only export found. The nearest is "Export…" in the conversation title menu (apps/web/features/chat/components/ConversationTitleMenu.tsx), which exports the whole conversation, not a recording transcript.

S49.27.note: No retention or delete control for voice recordings or transcripts found. The only retention control is the workspace "Retention window" in apps/web/features/settings/sections/WorkspacePolicySection.tsx, which is not shown to be about voice. The store has an internal clearTranscript (apps/web/features/chat/stores/voice-input-store.ts), with no button found.

S49.30.note: Dictated text is added with appendText (ChatComposerNew.tsx ~line 1996), and clear and setText purge undo history (ChatComposerNew.tsx ~line 1968); whether this insert joins undo history was not verified in a running app.
steps: Click "Start voice input", say a sentence, then click "Stop recording and edit the transcript" and wait for the text to land in the message box.
Click into the message box and press Cmd+Z.
Compare with Expected: the dictated text should be removed by the normal undo.
S49.30.where: Effect seen in the message box: Cmd+Z (the normal undo shortcut) after dictated text is inserted
